candidates.title: AINSI BAS LA VIDA (HARDTEKK)
candidates.suits: Relentless hardtekk rework in which the French vocal works as texture; suits fast, high-intensity cutting.
candidates.notes: 111k user videos and growing 11.6% a day on tokchart's live board, 30 Sep. tokchart is the only source carrying it, so the growth rate is one reading, not a consensus.

candidates.title: The Morning
candidates.suits: Slow nocturnal R&B with wide reverb and a long intro; suits night-time and atmospheric footage.
candidates.notes: 20k posts per Scott Social (28 Sep); 26k and rising per SocialPilot (14 Sep). Two sources agree, and the count is low enough to be early.

candidates.title: GEEKIN
candidates.suits: UK rap over a sparse, menacing low end with gaps to cut into; suits punchy, slow-impact edits.
candidates.notes: 18k posts and flagged new this week by Scott Social, 28 Sep. Single source, though the count is very early.

candidates.title: Eat Me Better
candidates.search: nimino (feat. Charlotte Plank) Eat Me Better
candidates.suits: Bright, garage-leaning electronic track that uses a chopped vocal as rhythm; suits fast-cut montages and transitions.
candidates.notes: Rising on both Buffer's and SocialPilot's TikTok lists. Two sources, though both lists are ageing.

candidates.title: Sunny
candidates.suits: Relentlessly bright four-to-the-floor dance rework of the disco original; suits joyful, high-energy montages.
candidates.notes: 290k per SocialPilot (14 Sep) and 169k per Scott Social (28 Sep), so the two sources disagree on scale. Either way the highest-use track in this run and the closest to its ceiling.

candidates.title: The Rivers of Belief
candidates.suits: Slow, spacious ambient instrumental of chant and pads; works as a calm background bed.
candidates.notes: 39k posts per Scott Social, 28 Sep, listed as an instrumental. Single source.

candidates.title: Reason To Stay
candidates.suits: Warm, unhurried UK soul-pop; suits text-overlay storytelling.
candidates.notes: 65k and rising per SocialPilot, 14 Sep. Single source and two weeks old at this run, so check it is still moving.

candidates.title: In & Out
candidates.suits: Smooth, airy R&B with a high, floating vocal; suits light, relaxed edits.
candidates.notes: 4.5k posts and flagged new by Scott Social, 28 Sep. The earliest entry in this run by a wide margin, and so the least proven.

candidates.title: Autumn Colors
candidates.suits: Warm, unhurried seasonal instrumental; works as a background bed for autumn-themed footage.
candidates.notes: 55k posts per Scott Social, 28 Sep. Single source.

candidates.title: Summer Vibes
candidates.suits: Bright instrumental loop with no vocal that loops cleanly to any length; works as an upbeat background bed.
candidates.notes: 78k posts per Scott Social, 28 Sep, listed as instrumental. Single source.

candidates.title: Bass Persuades
candidates.suits: Driving pop with a heavy low end and a central vocal; works where the track leads the edit.
candidates.notes: 78k and rising per SocialPilot, 14 Sep. Single source and two weeks old at this run.

candidates.title: Patient Zero
candidates.suits: Vocal-forward pop with a strong lyric hook; works where the lyric carries the post, such as text-overlay edits.
candidates.notes: 53k posts and flagged new by Scott Social, 28 Sep. Single source.

candidates.title: Pure
candidates.suits: Restrained singer-songwriter arrangement with space around the vocal; suits quiet, reflective posts.
candidates.notes: 41k posts per Scott Social, 28 Sep. Single source.

candidates.title: Someday We Will Dream About Today
candidates.search: The Sways Someday We Will Dream About Today
candidates.suits: Wistful indie known as a nostalgia-recap sound; suits look-back and recap edits.
candidates.notes: 213k posts per Scott Social, 28 Sep: the highest count in this run and already well used, so filed as peaking, not rising.
